messages:
maria: Quick PSA — found a couple of weird parse failures in the structured-output guide when using optional arrays + union types. Repro and minimal example below.

jon: also saw something similar in the SDK snippet tests, thanks for flagging.

maria: repro: model returns either {"items": [string]} or null. our parser assumes array always present which crashes the shim. Example:

```json
{"result": {"items": null}}
```

alex: ah, we should add the `nullable` note in the schema examples and show `items: [] | null` handling. Want me to open a docs PR?

tanya: please do — also add a code snippet for the JS SDK showing `const items = resp.result.items ?? []` as fallback.

sam: FYI the prod parser already tolerates null arrays if you use `allowNull` flag, but docs don't mention that flag anywhere.

maria: right — that's the missing piece. Suggested checklist for PR:
- add nullable array example in JSON Schema
- add JS and Python SDK snippets with null fallback
- call out `allowNull` parser option
- link to the parser behavior tests

jon: I'll add a short test in the snippet suite and point the PR to me for review. PR number when ready?

alex: Opening PR now —  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4825 : includes schema, JS/Python snippets, and a small unit test.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #4825 — lint ok, snippet-tests running :gear:

tanya: quick ask — can we keep the examples minimal (2-3 lines max) and add an expanded example as a hidden collapsible? long code blocks scare readers.

maria: agreed. We'll keep the top-level example tiny and add an expanded example under a "More examples" section.

sam: also add a note in the migration guide about older SDKs not exposing `allowNull` — link to the smallest compatible version.

alex: added that compatibility note + migration snippet. Also updated the structured-output table to include `nullable` column.

jon: Reviewing now. One small grammar nit and a missing import in the Python snippet.

alex: fixed both, pushed. CI green for snippets.

maria: thanks — can someone add a crosslink from the function-calling page to this section? it's easy to miss.

tanya: on it. I'll open a docs redirect PR to add the anchor link to function-calling examples.

ci-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-4825--docs.redwood.ai

sam: preview looks good. behavior matches the unit test.

maria: great — let's ship after one more review cycle. tagging @alex @jon for final sign-off :shipit:

alex: LGTM

jon: LGTM

maria: merging now. Thanks team! :tada:
